expected_level_description: You can: - run the governance cycle for boards and committees - review policies and advise on compliance
You can: - run the risk process for a directorate or programme - assess risks against the risk appetite and escalate them - report on risks to committees
You can: - plan assurance mapping across the organisation's main risks - work with internal and external auditors to agree scope and findings - report on assurance gaps to committees
You can: - draft and review policies with subject experts - check policies against law, standards, and equality duties - monitor compliance and report gaps
You can: - explain how health IT systems can harm patients, for example through wrong, missing, or delayed information - report a possible clinical safety issue through the right route
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession

You can: - work with the team to develop and maintain an understanding of stakeholders - work with the team to develop and implement stakeholder communications strategies - identify and resolve issues, influence stakeholders and manage relationships effectively - build long-term strategic relationships and communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders
You can: - work with higher impact or more complex risks, advising on the impact and whether it's within risk tolerance - apply different risk methodologies in proportion to the risk
